Container.Name: Foundry
Container.Overview:
This Docker will download and install SteamCMD. It will also install Foundry Dedicated Server and run it.
ATTENTION: First Startup can take very long since it downloads the gameserver files!
Update Notice: Simply restart the container if a newer version of the game is available.
You can also run multiple servers with only one SteamCMD directory!

This Docker will download and install SteamCMD. It will also install Foundry Dedicated Server and run it.

Update Notice: Simply restart the container if a newer version of the game is available.

Config.Name: SteamCMD
Config.Description: Container Path: /serverdata/steamcmd

Config.Name: ServerFiles
Config.Description: Container Path: /serverdata/serverfiles

Config.Name: GAME_ID
Config.Description: The GAME_ID that the container downloads at startup (2915550 for Foundry Dedicated Server).

Config.Name: GAME_PARAMS
Config.Description: Enter your extra start up commands for the server here otherwise leave empty.

Config.Name: Steam-Username
Config.Description: Your Steam username goes here if you want to install a game that needs a valid account, otherwise leave it blank (ATTENTION: You have to disable Steam Guard).

Config.Name: Validate Installation
Config.Description: Set the Variable to 'true' if you want to validate the installation otherwise leave it blank.

Config.Name: Steam-Password
Config.Description: Your Steam password goes here if you want to install a game that needs a valid account, otherwise leave it blank (ATTENTION: You have to disable Steam Guard).

Config.Name: Server Name
Config.Description: Name of the Server

Config.Name: World Name
Config.Description: Name of the Server World

Config.Name: Server Password
Config.Description: Server Password (leave blank for no password)

Config.Name: Public Server
Config.Description: List Server as Public (set to '0' to disable or set to '1' to enable).

Config.Name: UDP - Game Port
Config.Description: UDP Game Port (default 3724)

Config.Name: UDP - Query Port
Config.Description: UDP Query Port (default 27015)

Config.Name: GAME_PORT
Config.Description: Game Port - must match the UDP Game Port mapping above.

Config.Name: QUERY_PORT
Config.Description: Query Port - must match the UDP Query Port mapping above.

Config.Name: Max Players
Config.Description: Maximum number of players allowed on the server (default 4).

Config.Name: Pause When Empty
Config.Description: Pause the server when no players are connected (set to 'true' or 'false').

Config.Name: Autosave Interval
Config.Description: Autosave interval in seconds (default 300 = 5 minutes).

Config.Name: UID
Config.Description: Only change if you know what you are doing!

Config.Name: GID
Config.Description: Only change if you know what you are doing!
